<noinclude><pagequality level="1" user="DjR" /></noinclude><section begin="par112"/>of {{GHGheb|text=יַדְלִיקֵם}}); {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=28|verse=28}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=12|verse=3}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ho|chapter=4|verse=3}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ho|chapter=7|verse=7|hidebook=1}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=90|verse=6}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jb|chapter=14|verse=9}}; also in dependent clauses, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Lv|chapter=20|verse=18}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=29|verse=8.11 f.}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Am|chapter=5|verse=19}}.

{{GHGmargin-letter|112|n}}
(β) After a participle, as the equivalent of a sentence representing a contingent action, &c., e.g. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ex|chapter=21|verse=12}} {{GHGheb|text=מַכֵּה אִישׁ וָמֵת}} (instead of {{GHGheb|text=מַכֵּה}} there is in verse 20, &c. {{GHGheb|text=וְכִי יַכֶּה אִישׁ}}) {{GHGtranslate|if one smite a man and ''(so that)'' he die}}, &c., {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ex|chapter=21|verse=16}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=29|verse=15}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Am|chapter=6|verse=1}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Hb|chapter=2|verse=12}}.

{{GHGmargin-letter|112|o}}
(γ) After an infinitive absolute, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=7|verse=9}} f. {{GHGtranslate|will ye steal, murder, and commit adultery}} (simple infinitives absolute; cf. {{GHGpar|113|ee}}), {{GHGheb|text=וּבָאתֶם|translate=and then come and stand before me... and say}}, &c.; cf. below, {{GHGpar|112|u|nonumber=1}}.

{{GHGmargin-letter|112|p}}
(''c'') To express {{GHGterm|future}} actions, &c., as the temporal or logical consequence of tenses, or their equivalents, which announce or require such future actions or events. Thus—

(α) After imperfects in the sense of a simple future, e.g. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Am|chapter=9|verse=3}} f. {{GHGheb|text=מִשָּׁם אֲחַפֵּשׂ וּלְקַחְתִּים|translate=I will search and take them out thence}}, &c.; {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=4|verse=14}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=40|verse=13|hidebook=1}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ex|chapter=7|verse=3}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 S|chapter=17|verse=32}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 K|chapter=5|verse=11}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jb|chapter=8|verse=6}} f. (also with a change of subject, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=27|verse=12}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ju|chapter=6|verse=16}}, &c.); and in interrogative sentences, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=39|verse=9}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ex|chapter=2|verse=7}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 S|chapter=12|verse=18}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 K|chapter=14|verse=10}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Am|chapter=8|verse=8}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=41|verse=6}}; cf. also {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ru|chapter=1|verse=11}}; in sentences expressing a wish, {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 S|chapter=15|verse=4}}; as well as in almost all kinds of dependent clauses. Also in conditional clauses after {{GHGheb|text=אִם־}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=32|verse=9}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ex|chapter=19|verse=5}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 S|chapter=1|verse=11}}, or {{GHGheb|text=כִּי}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=37|verse=26}}, or {{GHGheb|text=הֵן}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=3|verse=1}}; in final clauses after {{GHGheb|text=לְמַ֫עַן}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=12|verse=13}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Nu|chapter=15|verse=40}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=28|verse=13}}; after {{GHGheb|text=אֲשֶׁר}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Dt|chapter=2|verse=25}}, or {{GHGheb|text=פֶּן־}} {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=3|verse=22}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=19|verse=19|hidebook=1}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=32|verse=12|hidebook=1}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=6|verse=10}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Am|chapter=5|verse=6}}; in temporal clauses, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=32|verse=15}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=13|verse=16}}; and in relative clauses, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=24|verse=14}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ju|chapter=1|verse=12}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 S|chapter=17|verse=26}}.

{{GHGmargin-letter|112|q}}
(β) After the jussive (or an imperfect in the sense of a jussive or optative) or cohortative, with the same or a different subject, e.g. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=1|verse=14}} f. {{GHGheb|text=יְהִי מְאֹרֹת... וְחָיוּ|translate=let there be lights... and let them be}}, &c.; {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=24|verse=4}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=28|verse=3|hidebook=1}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=31|verse=44|hidebook=1}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 K|chapter=1|verse=2}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 K|chapter=22|verse=13|hidebook=1}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ru|chapter=2|verse=7}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 Ch|chapter=22|verse=11}}; after a jussive expressing an imprecation, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ps|chapter=109|verse=10}}.

{{GHGmargin-letter|112|r}}
(γ) After an imperative, also with the same or a different subject, e.g. {{GHGbible-ref|book=2 S|chapter=7|verse=5}} {{GHGheb|text=לֵךְ וְאָֽמַרְתָּ|translate=go and tell}} (that thou mayst tell), &c., and often, {{GHGterm|perf. consec.}} after {{GHGheb|text=לֵךְ}} (as also the {{GHGterm|perf. consec.}} of {{GHGheb|text=אָמַר}} and {{GHGheb|text=דִּבֶּר}} very frequently follows other imperatives); {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=6|verse=14}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=8|verse=17|hidebook=1}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=27|verse=43|hidebook=1}} f., {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 S|chapter=15|verse=3}}, 18, {{GHGbible-ref|book=1 K|chapter=2|verse=36}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=48|verse=26}}.

{{GHGmargin-letter|112|s}}
(δ) After perfects which express a definite expectation or assurance (cf. {{GHGpar|106|m}} and n), e.g. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=17|verse=20}} {{GHGheb|text=הִנֵּה בֵּרַ֫כְתִּי אֹתוֹ וְהִפְרֵתִי אֹתוֹ|translate=behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful}}, &c.; {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=2|verse=11}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Is|chapter=5|verse=14|hidebook=1}}; on {{GHGbible-ref|book=Am|chapter=4|verse=7}} see above, note 3 on h; in an interrogative sentence, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ju|chapter=9|verse=9}}, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Ju|chapter=11|verse=13|hidebook=1}}.

{{GHGmargin-letter|112|t}}
(ε) After a participle, e.g. {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=7|verse=4}} {{GHGtranslate|for yet seven days}}, {{GHGheb|text=אָֽנֹכִי מַמְטִיר|translate=and I will cause it to rain}}... {{GHGheb|text=וּמָחִ֫יתִי|translate=and I will}} (i.e. in order to) {{GHGtranslate|destroy}}, &c.; {{GHGbible-ref|book=Jer|chapter=21|verse=9}}; also with a different subject, {{GHGbible-ref|book=Gn|chapter=24|verse=43}} f. ''the''<section end="par112"/><noinclude>
